title: Packing List
description: Normative JSON Schema for S2 – Packing List Schema of the KAPRI Specification Suite.
$comment: This schema references the common data types defined by SC1 – Common Data Types.

schema_version.description: SC1 §4.3 Schema Version. Version of the referenced Packing List schema.

packing_list_id.description: SC1 §4.5 URI. Unique identifier of the Packing List.

files.description: Collection of Package Files described by this Packing List.

file.description: Structure defined by S2 §3.1 Packing List Structure. Individual properties reference the SC1 Common Data Types listed below.

file_id.description: SC1 §4.18 File Identifier. Stable identifier of the Package File.

path.description: SC1 §4.6 File Path. Path of the Package File relative to the Package root directory.

media_type.description: SC1 §4.8 Media Type. RFC 6838 media type of the serialized file.

size.description: SC1 §4.19 File Size. Size of the serialized file in bytes.

hash_algorithm.description: SC1 §4.11 Hash Algorithm. Cryptographic hash algorithm used to calculate the Hash.

hash.description: SC1 §4.10 Hash. Cryptographic digest of the serialized file.

key_id.description: SC1 §4.15 Key Identifier. Identifies the symmetric File Key required to decrypt this encrypted Package File.
